review_notes: Source-first scope: the paper’s abstract and introduction make the fraud–equity-incentive relation its central question and explicitly compare both matched and unmatched control samples. The principal models are the full-control specifications for SENSITIVITY and VESTED STOCK AND OPTION SENSITIVITY in each design (Table 5 columns B/D; Table 6 columns B/D). The unmatched sample is a fully estimated logit comparison discussed in the abstract, not only a descriptive comparison. The no-control columns A/C are nested estimates; Table 4 is descriptive, and Table 7’s ex-post stock sales/option exercises are a separate follow-up question.

The table captions identify logit as the actual estimator. The paper shows chi-square p-values but does not state the covariance/standard-error correction. The only displayed equation (1) is conceptual; complete RHS terms come from Tables 5 and 6.

FINANCING has a strict-versus-weak inequality discrepancy at −0.5; Altman’s Z construction is not printed. The paper describes 1st/99th-percentile winsorization in Table 4 descriptive statistics but does not say whether this preprocessing is applied to Table 5/6 regression inputs.
results_review_notes: All four frozen full-control baseline columns are extracted: Table 5 B/D (matched) and Table 6 B/D (unmatched). Other table columns and additional analyses are excluded.

Table 4 descriptive values are retained for the accused-fraud, matched nonfraud, and unmatched nonfraud samples. Mean/median difference p-values are excluded as hypothesis tests; the separate matching-only TOTAL ASSETS row is excluded because it is not a retained RHS variable.
Individual coefficient p-values are copied directly from the reported Chi-Square p-value columns; no unreported coefficient statistic or degrees of freedom is inferred.
Source definitions retain the unresolved strict/inclusive FINANCING threshold and do not provide the exact ALTMAN’S Z construction.

Source-first comparison found that two Table 6 column B cells in the matching prior enrichment had been copied from column D; corrected CEO=CHAIR and NUMMTGS to the original Table 6 B cells. Table 4 descriptive values, roles, stable IDs, sample groups, and links were source-checked.
